Original Text: “灰礼帽”
Reference: 'Trilby Asher'
Translation: «Серый цилиндр»

Original Text: 锏
Reference: Degenbrecher
Translation: Цзянь

Original Text: 老练的士兵
Reference: Seasoned Soldier
Translation: Опытный солдат

Original Text: ......就是说那个蜂蜜饮料啊，喝起来甜滋滋的，没想到后劲大得很！
Reference: ...That's the honey drink I'm talking about. It's got a sweet taste at first, but I didn't expect it to hit me so hard after!
Translation: ……就是说，那种蜂蜜饮料，喝起来甜滋滋的，没想到后劲儿那么大！

Original Text: 不过对我来说也就一般般啦，我朋友还说我醉蜜，结果呢，我精神得很，她倒是先倒下了。
Reference: It wasn't really all that bad, though. My friend said I was honey drunk, but in the end, I was as sober as can be, and she was totally wasted.
Translation: 不过对我来说也就一般般吧。我朋友还说我喝了会“醉蜜”，结果呢？我精神得很，她倒是先倒下了。

Original Text: 嗯？喂喂，大叔？
Reference: Hm? Hey? Dedushka?
Translation: 嗯？喂喂，大叔？

Original Text: 喂——你在听吗——
Reference: Hey! Are you listening?
Translation: 喂——你在听吗——

Reference: Hmm...

Original Text: 啊？
Reference: Oh?
Translation: 啊？

Original Text: 恕我失礼，罗莎琳，你刚刚说什么？
Reference: Forgive me, Rosalind. What did you just say?
Translation: 抱歉失礼了，罗莎琳，你刚才说了什么？

Original Text: 我说我朋友醉蜜！
Reference: She was totally blitzed on honey!
Translation: 我说我朋友喝了会“醉蜜”！

Original Text: 哦，是的是的，没错，醉蜜。
Reference: Oh, right, right. Of course, on honey.
Translation: 哦，是的是的，没错，醉蜜。

Reference: Ugh... c'mon...
Translation: ……啧，真麻烦……

Original Text: 大叔你要是有什么在意的事，就先去解决一下呗。
Reference: If you have something on your mind, you should just deal with it.
Translation: 大叔，你要是有什么在意的事，就先去处理一下呗。

Original Text: 现在这副魂不守舍的样子，根本没法聊。
Reference: You're barely even here. How are we supposed to have a conversation?
Translation: 现在你这魂不守舍的样子，根本没法聊。

Original Text: 不不，现在可没有什么比罗莎琳你的故事更值得我在意的。
Reference: No, no, there is nothing more worthy of my attention than your story right now.
Translation: 不不，现在可没有什么比罗莎琳你的故事更值得我在意的了。

Original Text: 继续说说醉蜜的事吧，罗莎琳，我记得列车上应该也有卖含蜂蜜的特产饮料。
Reference: Please, tell me more about honey drunkenness. If I recall correctly, they do offer specialty beverages made with honey on this train.
Translation: 继续说说那个醉蜜的事吧，罗莎琳。我记得列车上应该也有卖含蜂蜜的特产饮料。

Original Text: 行了，少骗人。
Reference: Alright, that's enough.
Translation: 得了，少骗人了。

Original Text: 我这双眼睛利着呢，从刚刚那个戴帽子的家伙来开始，大叔你就不太对劲了。
Reference: My eyes are pretty sharp. You've been acting weird since that guy in the hat showed up.
Translation: 我这双眼睛可锐利着呢。从刚才那个戴帽子的家伙出现开始，大叔你就不太对劲了。

Original Text: 你们是朋友......不对，我看不像。
Reference: Is he your friend...? No, you don't look like friends.
Translation: 你们是朋友……不对，看起来不像。

Original Text: 那就是仇人？
Reference: So you must be enemies?
Translation: 那就是仇人？

Original Text: ......这倒也称不上。
Reference: Not quite.
Translation: ……这倒也称不上。

Original Text: 或许用“同僚”勉强能概括我与那位先生的关系，尽管我们在“公司”内并非隶属同一部门。
Reference: Perhaps the two of us can just barely be described as colleagues. We don't work for the same department of the company, however.
Translation: 或许用“同僚”勉强能概括我与那位先生的关系，尽管我们在“公司”内并非隶属同一部门。

Original Text: 哦，那就是休假时撞见关系不怎么样的同事。
Reference: Okay, so he's a colleague you don't get along with, bumping into you on vacation.
Translation: 哦，那就是休假时撞见了关系不怎么样的同事呗。

Original Text: 我喜欢这个说法。
Reference: I love the way you describe it.
Translation: 我喜欢这个说法。

Original Text: 好吧，罗莎琳，我承认我有点担心我的同僚能否顺利完成他的工作，所以，原谅我要失陪一会。
Reference: Right then, Rosalind. I'll admit I'm a little worried my colleague may not get his work done quite satisfactorily, so please excuse me for a short while.
Translation: 好吧，罗莎琳，我承认我有点担心我的同僚能否顺利完成工作。所以，原谅我要失陪一会儿。

Original Text: 作为补偿，我会给你带蜂蜜饮料，主要原料是谢拉格特产高地蜂蜜，每一滴都是耶拉冈德的恩赐，天然纯净......
Reference: By way of apology, I will secure for you a honey beverage. Its main ingredient is a Kjerag specialty, highland honey. Each and every drop is Kjeragandr's blessing, pure and unadulterated...
Translation: 作为补偿，我会为你带来蜂蜜饮料。主要原料是谢拉格特产高地蜂蜜，每一滴都是耶拉冈德的恩赐，天然纯净……

Original Text: 真的？但我已经要对这套耶拉冈德广告词无感了......
Reference: Really? I'm pretty much desensitized to all that Kjeragandr marketing talk though...
Translation: 真的？但我已经对这套耶拉冈德广告词免疫了……

Original Text: 千真万确。
Reference: Without a doubt.
Translation: 千真万确。

Original Text: 不过你的朋友说你会醉蜜，我想我们需要做个约定——每天最多一瓶，以防你在旅行期间真的喝醉。
Reference: But you did tell me your friend said you get honey drunk, so I'd like us to make a promise to one other. One bottle per day, at most. Let's keep you from actually getting drunk on our trip.
Translation: 不过既然你朋友说你会“醉蜜”，我想我们需要做个约定——每天最多一瓶，以防你在旅行期间真的喝醉。

Original Text: 我们之间没有如此剑拔弩张的必要，锏女士。
Reference: There's no need for things to be so tense between us, Madam Degenbrecher.
Translation: 我们之间没有如此剑拔弩张的必要，锏女士。

Original Text: 公爵阁下心系喀兰贸易，同时也关注谢拉格的发展，为其留意谢拉格的方方面面，是我的工作。
Reference: Her Grace's heart lies with Karlan Trade, and she is also keenly interested in Kjerag's continued development. It is my job to keep an eye on all aspects of the country.
Translation: 公爵阁下心系喀兰贸易，同时也关注谢拉格的发展，为其留意谢拉格的方方面面，是我的工作。

Original Text: 这次自然也不例外，您不必如此防范。
Reference: This is no different. There's no reason for you to be on alert.
Translation: 这次自然也不例外，您不必如此防范。

Original Text: 你的工作，包括参观列车的包厢？
Reference: So your job description includes visiting train cabins?
Translation: 你的工作，包括参观列车的包厢吗？

Original Text: 这里的变化惊人，不是吗？
Reference: The changes this place has been through are quite shocking, are they not?
Translation: 这里的变化惊人，不是吗？

Original Text: 据我所知，这条从圣山脚下到银心湖的线路上，投入使用的列车都是自维多利亚引进的车型。
Reference: From what I understand, they've deployed Victorian rolling stock on this route extending from the foot of Mount Karlan to Lake Silberneherze.
Translation: 据我所知，这条从圣山脚下到银心湖的线路上，投入使用的列车都是自维多利亚引进的车型。

Original Text: 不过这一系列与当初引进时相比，已经有了很大的变化。
Reference: But this series of trains has gone through significant modification since its initial deployment.
Translation: 不过这一系列与当初引进时相比，已经有了极大的改进。

Original Text: 只用短短三年时间就能够做到这一步，喀兰贸易在技术上的发展，令最早在此事上牵线的公爵阁下也颇为赞叹。
Reference: As the first to sow the seeds in all this, Her Grace is struck with admiration for Karlan Trade's technological improvements in these three short years.
Translation: 只用短短三年时间就能做到这一步，喀兰贸易在技术上的发展，令最早在此事上牵线的公爵阁下也颇为赞叹。

Original Text: 诺希斯如果做不到，那为他力排众议的恩希欧迪斯就该头疼了。
Reference: If Gnosis hadn't done all this, then Enciodes would've been in deep trouble after speaking up for him.
Translation: 诺希斯要是做不到这点，那为他力排众议的恩希欧迪斯就该头疼了。

Original Text: 你打算和我聊聊技术？
Reference: You're going to discuss technology with me?
Translation: 你打算和我聊聊技术？

Original Text: 那你找错人了，直接去找诺希斯聊，搞不好他还会有点兴趣。
Reference: You're talking to the wrong person, then. Better find Gnosis yourself. He might be interested.
Translation: 那你找错人了，直接去找诺希斯聊吧，搞不好他还会有点兴趣。

Original Text: ......我很好奇，女士。
Reference: Most curious, Madam.
Translation: ……我很好奇，女士。

Original Text: 我没想到会在这里遇见您，还是在这样的情况下。
Reference: I did not expect to find you here, much less under these circumstances.
Translation: 我没想到会在这里遇见您，还是在这样的情况下。

Original Text: 是什么人值得您亲自出手？是多么棘手的状况，能让您急迫到......没有时间更换一双沾满血污的手套？
Reference: Who exactly is it that necessitated your personal intervention? What kind of situation could be so urgent and precarious that... you haven't even the time to change your bloodstained gloves?
Translation: 是什么人值得您亲自出手？是多么棘手的状况，能让您急迫到……连更换一双沾满血污的手套的时间都没有？

Original Text: 解决了一点小麻烦。
Reference: I dealt with a small issue, that's all.
Translation: 解决了一点小麻烦而已。

Original Text: 劝你收起不合时宜的好奇心，“灰礼帽”。
Reference: This is not the right time for your curiosity, Trilby Asher, and I suggest you abandon it.
Translation: 劝你收起不合时宜的好奇心，“灰礼帽”。

Original Text: 我只是来找人的，暂时还不想再弄脏一双手套。
Reference: I'm here looking for someone, and I don't want to dirty another pair of gloves for the time being.
Translation: 我只是来找人的，暂时还不想再弄脏一双手套。

Original Text: 无意冒犯。
Reference: I mean no offense.
Translation: 无意冒犯。

Original Text: 我绝无干涉锏女士行动的意思。
Reference: And I don't mean to interfere with your work in any way.
Translation: 我绝无干涉锏女士行动的意思。

Original Text: 只是，想必在车上的一定是位重要人物......
Reference: It's just... surely there must be someone important aboard?
Translation: 只是，想必在车上的一定是位重要人物……

Original Text: 是又如何？
Reference: And if there is?
Translation: 是又如何？

Original Text: 如果您不介意透露些许，或许我能为您效劳。
Reference: If you wouldn't mind divulging some details to me, perhaps I could be of some assistance.
Translation: 如果您不介意透露些许，或许我能为您效劳。

Original Text: 毕竟“寻人”......这也算是我们的日常工作之一。
Reference: After all... finding people is one of the tasks that we handle on a day-to-day basis.
Translation: 毕竟“寻人”……这也算是我们的日常工作之一。

Original Text: 你好像搞错了什么。
Reference: You seem to be mistaken.
Translation: 你好像搞错了什么。

Original Text: 什么？
Reference: I beg your pardon?
Translation: 什么？

Original Text: 恩希欧迪斯默许你们在他身边探头探脑，那是他的事，我不会管。
Reference: Enciodes might be willing to turn a blind eye to you sticking your nose here. That's his choice, and none of my business.
Translation: 恩希欧迪斯默许你们在他身边探头探脑，那是他的事，我不会管。

Original Text: 但我没那么好的耐心。
Reference: But I don't share his patience.
Translation: 但我没那么好的耐心。

Original Text: 你知道谢拉格比卡西米尔好在哪吗？
Reference: Do you know what's so much nicer about Kjerag than Kazimierz?
Translation: 你知道谢拉格比卡西米尔好在哪吗？

Original Text: 这里冷是冷了点，相对的，虫子就少一些。
Reference: The place is cold, but consequently, there aren't as many insects around.
Translation: 这里冷是冷了点，但相对的，虫子就少一些。

Original Text: 那些让人心烦的飞虫，总是让人有伸手碾死的冲动。
Reference: The flying ones buzz around until you can't help but squash them dead.
Translation: 那些让人心烦的飞虫，总是让人有伸手碾死的冲动。

Original Text: 收敛点，否则，我不介意替恩希欧迪斯动手。
Reference: Now you'd best behave yourself, or I will act in Enciodes's stead.
Translation: 收敛点，否则，我不介意替恩希欧迪斯动手。

Reference: Thank you for the advice.
Translation: ……多谢忠告。

Original Text: 是警告。
Reference: This is not advice. It's a warning.
Translation: 这是警告。

Original Text: 好了，废话够多了。你拖够时间了？
Reference: Enough chit-chat. Are you through wasting my time?
Translation: 好了，废话够多了。你拖够时间了吗？

Original Text: 很巧，我要找的就是刚刚在车厢门后面偷听的那位。
Reference: What luck, the man I'm looking for is eavesdropping on the other side of that door.
Translation: 很巧，我要找的正是刚才在车厢门后面偷听的那位。

Original Text: 呃。
Reference: Erk.
Translation: 呃。

Original Text: 锏女士——
Reference: Madam Degenbrecher—
Translation: 锏女士——

Original Text: 一道森冷白光在他的话说完前自眼前掠过。
Reference: Before he can finish his sentence, a flash of cold, white light sweeps past his field of vision.
Translation: 一道森冷的白光在他把话说完前自眼前掠过。

Original Text: “灰礼帽”的阻拦被压回腹中，他头顶标志性礼帽的帽檐无声裂开，躲藏在伪装之下的公爵密探终于露出惊惧的一角。
Reference: The pressure the Trilby Asher managed to exert is suppressed within himself. The signature hat on his head is suddenly split into two down its brim, at last revealing a hint of the fear the disguised spy is feeling.
Translation: “灰礼帽”的阻拦之语被压回腹中，他头顶标志性礼帽的帽檐无声裂开，躲藏在伪装之下的公爵密探终于露出惊惧的一角。

Original Text: 女人的手状似随意地搭在锏上。她的目光让“灰礼帽”清晰地意识到——
Reference: The woman's hand rests on her weapon, apparently casually. Her gaze makes it clear to the Trilby Asher that—
Translation: 女人的手状似随意地搭在剑柄上。她的目光让“灰礼帽”清晰地意识到——

Original Text: 此刻，自己正是猛兽眼中的猎物。
Reference: Right now, he is prey to a ferocious beast.
Translation: 此刻，自己正是猛兽眼中的猎物。

Original Text: 我不是很想让这辆列车报废。
Reference: I don't want this train decommissioned.
Translation: 我不是很想让这辆列车报废。

Original Text: 别让我说第二次。
Reference: Don't make me say it again.
Translation: 别让我说第二次。

Original Text: 让开。
Reference: Out of the way.
Translation: 让开。

Original Text: 或者你想躺下让路，也可以。
Reference: If you'd rather I make my own way, that would be fine, too.
Translation: 或者你想躺下让路，那也可以。

Original Text: （开玩笑吧？！）
Reference: (This has certainly got to be a joke!)
Translation: （开什么玩笑？！）

Original Text: （黑骑士，真是......如果是在卡西米尔，手上沾血的黑骑士可是能被印成珍稀隐藏闪卡的！）
Reference: (The Black Knight in the flesh... In Kazimierz, they would print the image of the bloodied Black Knight on rare foil cards!)
Translation: （黑骑士，真是……如果是在卡西米尔，手上沾血的黑骑士可是能被做成珍稀隐藏闪卡的！）

Original Text: （不光是“灰礼帽”，现在连黑骑士都出现在这趟列车上......？）
Reference: (Set the Trilby Asher aside... Even the Black Knight is on this train...?)
Translation: （不光是“灰礼帽”，现在连黑骑士也出现在这趟列车上了……？）

Original Text: （啊，还要加上我——一位维多利亚子爵，被黑骑士点名要找的重要人物。这真是群星荟萃！了不起！）
Reference: (Oh, and me—A Victorian viscount, personally named by the Black Knight as the one she's looking for. What a star-studded cast! Inconceivable!)
Translation: （啊，还要加上我——一位维多利亚子爵，被黑骑士点名要找的重要人物。这真是群星荟萃！了不起！）

Original Text: （我需要现在立刻有人来告诉我这是即兴娱乐，是个玩笑......我很需要！）
Reference: (I need somebody to tell me right now this is all some kind of impromptu entertainment... That's what I need!)
Translation: （我需要现在立刻有人来告诉我这是即兴娱乐，是个玩笑……我非常需要！）

Original Text: 里斯本？
Reference: Lisburn?
Translation: 里斯本？

Original Text: 我需要你现在立刻去确认喀兰贸易有没有异动——
Reference: I need you to check for me right now if Karlan Trade has made any strange moves—
Translation: 我需要你现在立刻去确认喀兰贸易有没有异动——

Original Text: 不，不对，先确认我们的人是否安全！
Reference: No, never mind. First, make sure our men are safe!
Translation: 不，不对，先确认我们的人是否安全！

Original Text: 我们的人？在营地的都没问题，送你去车站后我们正常返回，没有遭遇什么异常情况。
Reference: Our men? They're all fine in the barracks. We all went back after we chauffeured you to the station. Saw nothing strange whatsoever.
Translation: 我们的人？在营地的都没问题，送你去车站后我们正常返回，没有遭遇任何异常情况。

Original Text: 不过杰弗逊他们拼酒还没回来......我现在就让人联系他们。
Reference: But Jefferson and the lads are not yet back from their drinking contest... I'll have someone find them right now.
Translation: 不过杰弗逊他们拼酒还没回来……我现在就让人去联系他们。

Original Text: 怎么了，哈洛德，听你的语气，出状况了？
Reference: What's the matter, Harold? The way you're talking, is something up?
Translation: 怎么了，哈洛德，听你的语气，出状况了？

Original Text: 暂时没事。暂时。
Reference: Everything is fine for now. For now.
Translation: 暂时没事。暂时而已。

Original Text: 但愿是我想太多......
Reference: I hope I'm merely overthinking this...
Translation: 但愿是我想太多了……

Original Text: 总之，先确认杰弗逊他们现在的状态，让他们立刻汇报！就算是醉死了，也给我爬起来应一声再死！
Reference: Anyway, confirm their status and have them report in immediately! Even if they've drunk themselves to death, pick them back up and get them to report in before they drop dead again!
Translation: 总之，先确认杰弗逊他们现在的状态，让他们立刻汇报！就算是醉死了，也给我爬起来应一声再死！

Reference: Understood. I'm on it.
Translation: ……行，我立刻去办。

Reference: ...*sigh*.

Original Text: 耶拉冈德在上，如果真像谢拉格人说的那样，耶拉冈德无所不知，无处不在——
Reference: O Kjeragandr, if you're really omnipresent and omniscient as the people here say—
Translation: 耶拉冈德在上，如果真像谢拉格人说的那样，耶拉冈德无所不知、无处不在——

Original Text: 我看，现在就是您该显显灵的时候啦。
Reference: Now is the time for you to appear.
Translation: 我看，现在就是您该显显灵的时候了。

Original Text: 别把一个诚心的观光客往外推呀。
Reference: Please don't abandon a faithful traveler.
Translation: 别把一个诚心的观光客往外推呀。

Original Text: 万一最后做不成好客人，那我可就只能当个不受欢迎的恶客咯。
Reference: If I can't be a good, proper guest, I may have no choice but to be an unwelcome guest.
Translation: 万一最后做不成好客人，那我可就只能当个不受欢迎的恶客了。

Original Text: 目前就是这样了。
Reference: So that's the gist of it.
Translation: 目前就是这样了。

Original Text: 这里信号有点问题，我试了下，车厢里基本上接不到通讯，走道上还稍微好点。
Reference: The signal here is kinda wonky. I gave it a try, but I got almost no signal at all in the cabin. It's a little better in the corridor.
Translation: 这里信号有点问题，我试了下，车厢里基本上接不到通讯，走道上还稍微好点。

Original Text: 幸好之前拜托极光她们做了点准备，要不然估计还联系不上你们。
Reference: Good thing Aurora set this up for us ahead of time. Otherwise, I probably wouldn't have a way to get in touch.
Translation: 幸好之前拜托极光她们做了点准备，要不然估计还联系不上你们。

Original Text: 我能有什么事？放心，我好得很。
Reference: What could happen to me? Relax, I'm fine.
Translation: 我能有什么事？放心，我好得很。

Original Text: 哦！本舰就交给你们联系，帮我和其他人也问声好！
Reference: Alright! I'll leave it to you to get in touch with the landship. Say hello to the others for me!
Translation: 哦！本舰就交给你们联系了，帮我和其他人也问声好！

Original Text: 那就这样，先挂了。
Reference: I'll hang up now. Later.
Translation: 那就这样，先挂了。

Original Text: 这样应该就没问题了......
Reference: This should take care of it...
Translation: 这样应该就没问题了……

Original Text: 罗莎琳！
Reference: Rosalind!
Translation: 罗莎琳！

Original Text: 哇啊！！
Reference: Waugh!
Translation: 哇啊！！

Original Text: 是、是你啊大叔，吓了我一跳......
Reference: Oh, it's you. You spooked me...
Translation: 是、是你啊大叔，吓了我一跳……

Original Text: 你在跑什么？躲谁？
Reference: What are you doing? Are you running from somebody?
Translation: 你在跑什么？躲谁呢？

Original Text: 我很抱歉，不过现在不是说这个的好时候。
Reference: Terribly sorry, but now is not the time to discuss this.
Translation: 我很抱歉，不过现在不是说这个的好时候。

Original Text: 罗莎琳，你怎么不待在包厢里？
Reference: Rosalind, why didn't you stay in the cabin?
Translation: 罗莎琳，你怎么没待在包厢里？

Original Text: 呃，我出来透透气。
Reference: Uh, I wanted some fresh air.
Translation: 呃，我出来透透气。

Original Text: 有什么问题？
Reference: Got a problem with that?
Translation: 有什么问题吗？

Original Text: 哦没有，透透气当然没有问题。
Reference: Oh, not at all. Fresh air is a fine thing.
Translation: 哦没有，透透气当然没有问题。

Original Text: 只是——
Reference: It's just—
Translation: 只是——

Original Text: ......可惜，看来没有多少解释的时间了。
Reference: ...A shame. Seems we won't have much time for an explanation.
Translation: ……可惜，看来没有多少解释的时间了。

Original Text: 罗莎琳，你先回包厢——不，等等，不行，“灰礼帽”那家伙已经见过你了。
Reference: Rosalind, you go on back to the cabin—Wait, no, you can't. The Trilby Asher has already seen you.
Translation: 罗莎琳，你先回包厢——不，等等，不行，“灰礼帽”那家伙已经见过你了。

Original Text: （而且，那家伙说的“眼熟”......）
Reference: (Besides, he said she looked 'familiar'...)
Translation: （而且，那家伙说的“眼熟”……）

Original Text: “灰礼帽”？是说刚刚你那个戴帽子的同事？
Reference: Trilby Asher? You mean your colleague with the weird hat?
Translation: “灰礼帽”？是说刚才你那个戴帽子的同事？

Original Text: 是的，没错，就是他！
Reference: Yes, exactly. That's him!
Translation: 是的，没错，就是他！

Original Text: 我遇到一些小麻烦，罗莎琳。
Reference: I ran into some small trouble, Rosalind.
Translation: 我遇到了一些小麻烦，罗莎琳。

Original Text: 提前申明，将你卷入其中绝非我的本意，只不过......
Reference: Let me say this now. It was not my intent to bring you into this mess. However...
Translation: 提前申明，将你卷入其中绝非我的本意，只不过……

Original Text: 如果我不在，让一些奇怪的人找到机会和你搭讪就不好了。
Reference: I don't want some strange man to come propositioning you because he's failed to find me.
Translation: 如果我不在，让一些奇怪的人找到机会和你搭讪就不好了。

Original Text: 啊？搭讪？
Reference: Huh? Propositioning?
Translation: 啊？搭讪？

Original Text: 那种无聊的人别理就行了，要是还敢纠缠不休，就照着鼻子给他一拳！
Reference: I just ignore those weirdos. And if they can't take a hit, I sock 'em right in the nose!
Translation: 那种无聊的人别理就行了，要是还敢纠缠不休，就照着鼻子给他一拳！

Original Text: 不错的办法，之后有机会请务必这样做。
Reference: Not a bad idea. If ever you find the chance, please do.
Translation: 不错的办法，之后有机会请务必这样做。

Original Text: 不过总有些就算挨年轻女士的拳头，也不会轻易退却的难缠的家伙......
Reference: But there are certain men who don't give up simply because they've been punched in the face by a young lady...
Translation: 不过总有些就算挨了年轻女士的拳头，也不会轻易退却的难缠家伙……

Original Text: 所以，我想邀请你，罗莎琳。要不要一起去最前方的餐车，品尝蜂蜜饮料，顺便回避一些缠人的搭讪者？
Reference: So, I'd like to offer you an invitation to the dining car, to sample the honey beverages there and evade the stubborn flirts.
Translation: 所以，我想邀请你，罗莎琳。要不要一起去最前方的餐车，品尝蜂蜜饮料，顺便回避一些缠人的搭讪者？

Original Text: 唔，你的意思是，一起去整点蜂蜜饮料？
Reference: Hm, so you mean you want to drink honey with me?
Translation: 唔，你的意思是，一起去弄点蜂蜜饮料？

Original Text: 没错，我们去整点蜂蜜饮料。
Reference: Yes, let us proceed to imbibe the honey drink.
Translation: 没错，我们去弄点蜂蜜饮料。

Original Text: 是不是还要一路跑过去？
Reference: And you want to run all the way there?
Translation: 是不是还要一路跑过去？

Original Text: 哈哈，是的，一路跑过去。
Reference: Hah, yes, let us proceed to run all the way there.
Translation: 哈哈，是的，一路跑过去。

Original Text: 哈，大叔，后面追你的人快过来了吧，我都听到脚步声了！
Reference: Heh, they've almost caught up to you, haven't they? I can hear their footsteps!
Translation: 哈，大叔，后面追你的人快过来了吧，我都听到脚步声了！

Original Text: 你还真是一点都不遮掩。
Reference: You really aren't hiding none of it.
Translation: 你还真是一点都不遮掩啊。

Original Text: 我说过的，我不对女士说谎。
Reference: I said as much. I would never lie to a lady.
Translation: 我说过的，我不对女士说谎。

Original Text: 行啊，虽然不知道你们在闹什么名堂......
Reference: Alright, I've got no idea what kind of ruckus you guys are stirring up...
Translation: 行啊，虽然不知道你们在闹什么名堂……

Original Text: 但好像挺有意思的，我跟了！
Reference: But it sounds pretty fun. I'm in!
Translation: 但好像挺有意思的，我跟了！

Original Text: 荣幸之至。
Reference: Pleasure to have you onboard.
Translation: 荣幸之至。

Original Text: 那么事不宜迟——
Reference: Then, without further ado—
Translation: 那么事不宜迟——

Original Text: 现在，立刻，让我们跑起来！
Reference: Now! Quick, we have to run!
Translation: 现在，立刻，让我们跑起来！
